subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should OpenClaw core doctor fail closed and skip `groupAllowFrom` writes for external channel plugins whose schemas are unavailable to core?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but the fix changes a released upgrade-time config repair default for external plugins.

options.title: Land schema-verified guard
options.body: Merge this PR once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

options.title: Add external opt-in first
options.body: Pause this PR and design a plugin schema or doctor capability contract for external channels that want this migration.

options.title: Supersede only with proven broader fix
options.body: Use broader config-protection work only if it proves the same email/RCS upgrade regression and preserves this regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Land schema-verified guard
recommendation.body: Merge this PR once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored and merged the migration being narrowed, making it the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
